title: Guarantee Certificate Terms: Expiry, Extension, Forfeit and Withdrawal of the Traded Piece
content:
1. A credit issued under the Belrose Trade-In and Upgrade Programmes that reaches its expiry with something unspent is closed and what is left is taken away, and the programmes that issue credit without an expiry never reach this point.

2. Credit is taken away only while the registration stands at credit issued, partially redeemed, expired or revoked, and the reason is recorded as one of the closed set of grounds. The standing is read from the registration before the credit is taken away.

3. On the programmes that allow it, a credit about to expire may be extended once by the programme's extension in calendar days for the programme's extension fee, and the extension is arranged before the expiry, never after it. The extension fee is taken at the counter on its own till transaction rather than deducted from the credit, so the credit available to spend is never quietly reduced by a fee.

4. A credit taken away because the customer withdrew the traded piece is recorded under the withdrawal ground, and the piece is returned in the condition it came in.

5. Once a credit has been taken away it is not reinstated, and a customer who wishes to trade again begins a fresh registration.

The number of days the credit lasts, whether it may be extended, the extension in days, the extension fee and the window within which the traded piece may be withdrawn are the programme's published figures.

## Grounds and standings

| Ground on which credit is taken away | Recorded as |
|---|---|
| the credit reached its expiry unspent | the expiry ground |
| the customer withdrew the traded piece | the withdrawal ground |

| Standing of the registration | Credit may be taken away |
|---|---|
| credit issued | yes |
| partially redeemed | yes |
| expired | yes |
| revoked | yes |
| registered or appraisal pending | no |
| redeemed | no |

## Reading the terms

- An extension arranged on the day after the expiry is out of time: clause 3 admits an extension before the expiry only.
- A customer whose credit was taken away last year and who wishes to trade again begins a fresh registration; the old credit is not revived.
